privacy.title: Privacy on this hub
privacy.description: Vatra runs in your home. Your household's data stays on this hub unless the owner turns on a feature that needs the internet.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The person who set up this hub (the owner) decides what it stores and who can use it. For data kept only on the hub, the owner is the controller. Vatra's publisher, {publisher}, never receives that data. The publisher is responsible only for the optional Vatra Cloud services described below.

local.title: What this hub stores
items: Accounts: name, email, password hash (scrypt), passkeys, two-factor secrets (encrypted), sessions and language/appearance preferences.
Household: family roles, room permissions, invitations, paired phones and computers (name, platform, last IP, push tokens).
Home: Home Assistant devices and states, scenes, door and intercom events, notifications and their history.
Nutrition and water journal per member, if used: meals, macros, notes and coach messages.
Machines: cloud provider accounts and credentials (encrypted with the hub master key), VM inventory, terminal recordings you start.
Security log: an audit log of actions (who, what, when, result). Entries older than 30 days move to a compressed archive on the hub.

leaves.title: What leaves the hub, and only when switched on
items: Vatra Cloud remote access (off by default): an encrypted relay forwards connections to your hub. The relay sees the hub id, the client IP address and timing, never the content (TLS is end to end, the certificate key stays on the hub).
Vatra Cloud certificates: to get a certificate for [hub id].vatra.dragoscatalin.ro, the hub sends a one-time DNS challenge value through Vatra's proxy to the DNS provider.

Notifications on phones: via Apple Push Notification service, Google Firebase Cloud Messaging or a UnifiedPush server of your choice. With the Vatra Cloud push relay, the card is end-to-end encrypted for each device; the relay, Apple and Google see only the push token (inside an opaque handle), hub id, card id, kind, priority and timing.

AI assistant (off until you accept the AI notice): your question, the conversation and the tool results it needs go to the Ollama model server set in VMUI_OLLAMA_URL (by default on this machine, so nothing leaves). Nutrition coach: when the owner adds a codai key and has accepted the notice, journal totals (no names) go to the codai gateway (ai.codai.ro) to word one tip a day. See the AI section.
Cloud providers you connect (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Scaleway): the hub calls their APIs with your credentials.
Updates: the updater checks the public release list on GitHub (your hub's IP address is visible to GitHub).

ai.title: AI features
ai.body: AI answers are generated by a language model and can be wrong. Before the first use you are asked to accept; you can switch it off at any time on the AI page. Without your consent the hub sends nothing to an AI provider.

retention.title: How long data is kept
retention.body: Data stays on the hub until a member or the owner deletes it. Sessions expire after 30 days. The audit log keeps 30 days live, then an archive on the hub. Vatra Cloud services keep no message content; rate-limit counters live in memory for one day.

rights.title: Export and delete
rights.body: Members can delete their own account at /account/delete on this hub (administrators also in Settings › Security). The owner can export the whole hub as an encrypted backup (Settings › Backup) and can remove members. To erase everything, reset the hub (delete its data volume or reinstall the image). Questions about Vatra Cloud: {email}.

privacy.complaint: You can also complain to your data protection authority; in Romania that is ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro).
privacy.more: Full policies for the mobile and desktop apps and for Vatra Cloud are in docs/legal in the source code.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Vatra account
deleteAccount.description: Your account lives on your household's hub, not on Vatra's servers. Here is how to delete it and what is removed.

hub.title: On the hub (web)
steps: Open [your hub address]/account/delete (administrators also find it in Settings › Security).
Under Delete account, enter your password and confirm.

apps.title: In the Android, iOS and Windows apps
apps.body: The apps have no separate account: they act as your account on your hub. To delete it, open your hub in a browser (the address you paired with) and follow the steps above. To only disconnect a phone or computer, use Forget (Android, iOS) or Disconnect (Windows); the owner can also revoke a device in Home › Paired devices.

owner.title: If you own the hub
owner.body: The owner cannot delete their own account, because the hub would have nobody in charge. Transfer ownership to another adult first, or reset the hub: delete its data volume or reinstall the image. Everything on the hub is erased.

email.title: By email
email.body: If you can no longer sign in, ask your hub's owner to remove you (Home › Settings › Family). For Vatra Cloud data (push handles, relay records), email {email} from your account address. We answer within one month.

deleted.title: What is deleted
items: Your account: name, email, password, passkeys, two-factor settings, sessions and preferences.
Your household membership and room permissions.
Your nutrition and water journal and your AI consent.
Your paired phones and computers are revoked and their push tokens and encryption keys erased.

kept.title: What is kept
kept.body: The security log keeps a line saying an account was deleted (account id, time), for 30 days live and then in the hub's archive. Things you created for the whole household (scenes, rooms, schedules) stay, without your name.

accountCard.title: Delete account
accountCard.description: Remove your account and your personal data from this hub.
accountCard.body: Your account, journal, household membership and paired devices are removed. This can't be undone.
accountCard.confirmBody: You'll be signed out and your data on this hub erased. This can't be undone.
accountCard.ownerTitle: The owner can't delete their account
accountCard.ownerBody: Transfer ownership to another adult, or reset the hub to erase everything.
accountCard.lastAdminBody: Make another account an administrator first.

ai.consentTitle: Before you use the AI assistant
ai.consentIntro: Answers come from an AI language model, not a person. They can be wrong: check before you act on them.
ai.consentSent: When you send a message, the hub sends your question, the conversation so far and the results of the tools it uses (for example VM names, costs, audit entries) to the AI service configured on this hub.
ai.consentCoach: The nutrition coach also uses AI to word its daily tip, from journal totals only (no names).
ai.consentOff: You can switch AI off at any time on this page. Without your consent nothing is sent.
ai.off: AI is off. Turn it on to chat.
ai.turnedOff: AI turned off. Nothing more is sent.
ai.required: Turn on AI first: accept the notice above.
